title: UBIQUITOUS FUNCTIONAL SYNERGY PARTIALLY EXPLAINS WHY MOST TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR BINDING IS NON-FUNCTIONAL
authors: Chase Mateusiak; Eric Jia; Jessica N. Plaggenberg; Zolboo Erdenbataar; Yuchen Wang; Christian Shively; Guochen Liao; Robi D. Mitra; Michael R. Brent
one_liner_zh: 该文通过数学建模研究酵母中TF结合位点与基因表达响应的功能协同效应，虽涉及TF-DNA结合数据，但未聚焦三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属于广义TF-DNA互作的功能分析。
abstract: Most genes in whose promotor a transcription factor (TF) binds do not change in expression when the concentration of the TF is perturbed. No existing model can predict which bound promotors will respond and which will not. We hypothesized that a gene’s response to perturbation of a TF bound in its promotor can depend on which other TFs are bound there, a phenomenon we call functional synergy. This is distinct from cooperative binding, which is already accounted for in the binding location data. To investigate functional synergy, we created a comprehensive dataset on TF binding locations in yeast using a method that is orthogonal to chromatin immunoprecipitation. We then used mathematical modeling to identify high-confidence instances of functional synergy. We found that such synergies are surprisingly common. Responses to perturbations of 44 different TFs were modified by the presence of other TFs. 48 TFs served as modifiers, but some modified responses to many TFs. We conclude that (1) measuring the binding locations of a single TF will not, in general, reveal which genes the TF regulates, and (2) traditional networks linking TFs to their targets must be made substantially more expressive, allowing some TFs to modify the effects of others.
abstract_zh: 大多数基因，其启动子中结合了转录因子（TF），在TF浓度受到扰动时，其表达并不发生变化。现有模型无法预测哪些已结合的启动子会响应，哪些不会。我们假设，基因对其启动子中结合的TF扰动的响应，可能取决于该启动子上结合的其他TF，这一现象我们称之为功能协同（functional synergy）。这与协同结合（cooperative binding）不同，后者已在结合位置数据中有所体现。为研究功能协同，我们使用了一种与染色质免疫沉淀（chromatin immunoprecipitation）正交的方法，创建了酵母中TF结合位点的全面数据集。随后，我们利用数学建模来识别高置信度的功能协同实例。我们发现，这类协同现象出乎意料地普遍。对44种不同TF扰动的响应，受到其他TF存在的影响。48种TF作为修饰因子，但有些修饰因子影响了对多种TF的响应。我们得出结论：（1）仅测量单个TF的结合位置，通常无法揭示该TF调控哪些基因；（2）连接TF与其靶标的传统网络必须大幅增强表达能力，允许某些TF修饰其他TF的作用。
